The customary object language actually used for predictions in non-relativistic quantum mechanics is classical functional analysis developed in ZFC+analysis and reasoned in classical first-order logic in the meta-theory: a separable complex Hilbert space H, self-adjoint observables with spectral measures, states as rays/density operators, B(H) and C*/von Neumann algebras, Born rule. The native physical propositional structure is the orthomodular lattice L(H) of closed subspaces/projections.

Gödel’s
G(x) ≡ ∀P[Pos(P)→P(x)]
with S5+PosAx
Pos(P)→□Pos(P), Pos(P)→Pos(□P), Pos(E), closure of Pos under ∧,→, ¬Pos(¬P), etc.,
and S5 necessitation/iteration/Barcan is a quantified modal-metaphysical theorem.
□,◇, metaphysical Pos(P), essence and necessary existence are not primitives of the Hilbert-space/C*-algebraic object language. They have no canonical interpretation as bounded/unbounded operators on H, as elements of B(H) or as structure preserving maps on L(H). Physical positivity is spectral positivity A≥0, not Gödel metaphysical Pos, and necessity is not an observable. The axioms are not theorems of spectral calculus, Stone–von Neumann, CCR or the Born rule and have no operational content in states, observables and probabilities.

ZFC is indeed strong enough to code syntax, Kripke frames and quantified S5, so S5+PosAx and the Gödel derivation can be transcribed in the same set-theoretic meta-language in which H, B(H) and the spectral theorem are defined. That is the familiar formalisability/consistency-relative meta fact:
S5+PosAx ⊢ ∃x G(x)
is expressible in the classical ZFC background shared with QM, conditional on importing the modal-metaphysical premises by hand. The existence obtained is existence in a model of the imported axioms, not existence in H or in the algebra of observables.

On the physically intended internal reading the obstruction is decisive. L(H) is orthomodular, non-Boolean, non-distributive and has no canonical S5 necessity operator. The classical distributive closure of positive properties and the unrestricted S5 necessitation/Barcan steps used essentially in Gödel’s proof are not validated by the state-functional semantics on L(H); incompatible properties cannot be simultaneously possessed and Kochen–Specker type incompatibility blocks the simultaneous possession of all positive properties required for G. Imposing S5 externally breaks the *-representation and spectral interpretation.

Hence there is no unconditional, physically meaningful theorem ∃x G(x) of the customary Hilbert-space/C*-algebraic mathematics used for quantum mechanics, and no operational existence statement about a god-like entity in H or in the algebra of observables follows from states, observables and the Born rule. At most one has the conditional meta-mathematical fact that, if Gödel’s S5 positivity axioms are postulated as extra-physical premises, they can be formalised in the classical ZFC meta-theory that underlies QM and the conditional existence result follows there. In the customary physical, internal sense the existence of a Gödelian god-like entity is not provable from, nor even statable in, the standard quantum-mechanical formalism.

The customary object language that is actually used to make predictions in non-relativistic quantum mechanics is classical functional analysis: a separable complex Hilbert space H, self-adjoint observables with spectral measures, states as rays/density operators, B(H) and C*/von Neumann algebras, Born rule, all developed in ZFC+analysis and reasoned about in classical first-order logic. The native physical propositional content is the orthomodular lattice L(H) of closed subspaces/projections.

That language has vectors, inner products, operators, spectra and probabilities. It has no primitive □,◇, no metaphysical predicate Pos(P) in Gödel’s sense, no notion of essence or necessary existence, and no Kripke accessibility relation built into H, B(H) or L(H). Physical positivity is spectral positivity A≥0, not Gödel’s metaphysical Pos, and necessity is not an observable. □ has no canonical interpretation as a bounded/unbounded operator on H or as a structure-preserving map on L(H). A possible world is not a ray, density operator or state on a C*-algebra.

Gödel’s G(x)≡∀P[Pos(P)→P(x)] with Pos(P)→□Pos(P), Pos(P)→Pos(□P), Pos(E), closure of Pos under ∧,→, ¬Pos(¬P), etc., in quantified S5, and the derivation S5+PosAx ⊢ □∃x G(x) ⊢ ∃x G(x), is a modal-metaphysical theorem. Its usual soundness is read off Kripke semantics ⟨W,R⟩ with R an equivalence relation and w ⊩ □φ iff φ holds at all v with wRv. W,R,V are set-theoretic meta-objects in the background in which H is defined. That is set-theoretic meta-semantics for modal logic, not a piece of Hilbert-space/C*-algebraic mathematics.

It is true and trivial that ZFC, the background in which H, B(H) and the spectral theorem are defined, is strong enough to code syntax, Kripke frames and S5, so S5+PosAx can be transcribed in the same set-theoretic meta-language. That is formalisability/consistency-relative: in the classical meta-theory one can write down the imported modal positivity axioms and obtain the conditional consequence ∃x G(x). It is existence in a model of the imported axioms, not a theorem of the Hilbert-space/operator-algebraic object language itself, and it has no operational content in states, observables and the Born rule.

On the physically intended internal reading the obstruction is decisive. L(H) is orthomodular, non-Boolean, non-distributive and has no canonical S5 necessity operator. The classical distributive closure of positive properties and the unrestricted S5 necessitation/Barcan steps used essentially in Gödel’s proof are not validated by the state-functional semantics on L(H); incompatible properties cannot be simultaneously possessed in the quantum-logical semantics and Kochen–Specker type incompatibility blocks the simultaneous possession of all positive properties required for G. Imposing S5 externally breaks the *-representation and spectral interpretation that define the customary setting.

Hence there is no unconditional, physically meaningful theorem ∃x G(x) of the customary Hilbert-space/C*-algebraic mathematics used for quantum mechanics, and no operational existence statement about an entity in H or in the algebra of observables follows from quantum theory. At most we have the familiar conditional meta-mathematical fact that, if Gödel’s S5 positivity axioms are postulated as extra-physical premises, they can be formalised in the classical ZFC meta-theory that underlies QM. In the physics sense, internal to the customary formalism, the existence of a Gödelian god-like entity is not provable.
